name: Chicchai Idol DVD no Tsukurikata 2
original_name: ちっちゃいアイドルDVDのつくりかた2
source:
Filming an H video of a would-be-idol girl! She is as earnest as she devotes
herself to work on it while sandwiched between obscenity and pureness... 
Do whatever you want to her!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE228183.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
拍摄准偶像少女的色情录像！她一边被淫秽与纯真夹在中间，一边认真投入拍摄工作……
想对她做什么都可以！

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE228183.html]DLsite English[/url]）
